title: Hydra plan
description: A Hydra plan file (.hydra/plans/*.json): the same shape as hydra_plan_create. Run it with `hydra plan run <file>`.

title.description: A short name for the plan, under 200 characters.

brief.description: Optional: the task this plan comes from, for context.

key.description: A job's key within its plan, e.g. "schema".

title.description: A short name for the job, under 80 characters.

brief.description: Everything the job needs: goal, constraints, files, and how to know it is done. It has no other context beyond this and what its dependencies handed on.

write_scope.description: Repository-relative paths this job may change. Changes outside are refused.

items.description: A job's key within its plan, e.g. "schema".

depends_on.description: Keys of jobs in this same plan that must finish first. This job then starts from their results and is told what they did.

provider.description: Which agent runs this job. Defaults to the plan's, else yours.

role.description: A role from an active pack, as "pack/role", if one fits this job.

rigor.description: How much checking this job gets, on top of the project's own gates (never fewer than those). "quick": nothing extra. "standard" (the default): also a review by the other agent, if the project doesn't already review. "strict": the same, plus screenshots and an integration check when the project has them.

jobs.description: The plan's jobs. Keys must be unique within this plan; dependencies must form no cycle.

idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this request. Repeating a call with the same key returns the same plan instead of making another.

run.description: Optional, defaults to "attended". "unattended" takes heads only, needs a budget, and never asks anything while it runs.

budget.description: Required when run is "unattended": at least one cap. Refused if the plan's job count already exceeds max_jobs, or could plausibly cost more than usd.

usd.description: Total dollars across every job in the plan, checked against a worst-case estimate (job count × the per-head default budget) when the plan is created or amended — not a live spend meter, since Hydra doesn't track actual cost.

wall_clock_minutes.description: Minutes from when the plan starts running. Hydra cancels whatever is still going when it elapses.

max_jobs.description: The most jobs this plan may ever have, counting amendments.
